title: Invention of the Cotton Gin and Expansion of the Black Belt
note: Eli Whitney's mechanised cotton engine enabled rapid processing of short-staple cotton, driving the forced domestic migration of over one million enslaved people across the Deep South to feed British mills.

title: Luddite Uprisings in Northern England
note: Armed protests by artisanal textile workers smashing automated shearing frames and power looms in Nottinghamshire, Yorkshire, and Lancashire, met with military force and capital punishment.

title: Deindustrialization of Bengal Textile Manufacturing
note: Collapse of traditional Indian handloom spinning and weaving under British East India Company colonial trade policies and cheap Manchester mill exports, reversing India's historic role as a textile exporter.

title: Lowell Mill Girls Strike of 1834
note: Pioneering labour strike by 800 young female textile operatives in Lowell, Massachusetts protesting wage reductions, sparking the Factory Girls Association and early industrial labor organizing.
